caption: The drawing depicts a garden scene framed within an irregularly shaped rounded rectangle and set against a plain beige background. The scene features various objects, including several types of plants and trees rendered in shades of green, teal, white, and pink. Foreground elements include large flowers and leafy vegetation with white and pink petals and green and teal leaves. Toward the left side, there is an architectural element resembling a balcony or railing, illustrated with white and teal lines. In the background, two tall, thin cypress-like trees stand vertically with dark green foliage and pink trunks. Dense, bushy trees and shrubs occupy the center, featuring layered green and teal leaves with pink accents. On the right side of the composition is a domed structure with vertical columns, colored with green and pink outlines against a teal background. To the right of the structure, a bird with green and pink coloring is illustrated in flight. The entire garden scene is enclosed within the rounded shape, without touching the beige margins of the drawing.
title: Bandbox Design
